sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 610. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 60 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 90 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
Only [Gentle Behemoth] Titi can be used as Unlocking Potential material
